name: Yao Lai Dian Baihe Ma - Love Yuri
original_name: 要来点百合吗 Love Yuri
source:
Shu Yu, a popular writer who has no romantic experience but loves writing yuri love stories, becomes sisters with Lu Xi, an otaku and experienced online voice actress.

Although they share a strong bond, their relationship becomes awkward due to their own secrets.
However, when Lu Xi accidentally discovers that her favorite yuri author is actually her sister Shu Yu, she becomes increasingly attracted to her personality and a forbidden romance unfolds between them...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
舒谕是当红作家，没有恋爱经验，却热衷于创作百合爱情故事；鹿溪则是宅女，也是经验丰富的网络声优。两人成了姐妹。

虽然彼此感情深厚，却因为各自隐藏的秘密，关系逐渐变得尴尬。
然而，当鹿溪意外发现，最喜欢的百合作者竟然就是姐姐舒谕时，她愈发被舒谕的性情吸引，一段禁忌的恋情就此展开…

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439760/]Steam[/url]]
